prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1440×1000 desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT for Interview Book. Use the attached user-supplied screenshot only as visual reference for warm white editorial documentation, dark Chinese serif question title, understated nav, thin dividers, red numbered markers, blue topic links, and visible “中文 / EN” switch. It contributes style and clarity; do not copy its unsourced counts or IDs.

Composition A — a clear three-part reading path. Header: Interview Book, nav “问题索引 / 主题 / 岗位 / 晋升”, visible “中文 / EN”. A wide search field directly below, explicitly supporting Chinese and English. Left topic sidebar with names only and no counts. Main reading column: breadcrumb, previous/next links, stable question title “资源只够做两项时，你会如何制定下一季度规划？”. Under the title, a restrained horizontal three-stop guide labeled “考察意图 → 相关主题 → 来源与延伸”, each with one concise explanation. Below, three matching detailed sections with anchored red numbers, but do not repeat the exact summary text: intent says “了解你如何说明目标、取舍依据与暂缓项”; topics are “资源分配 / 优先级 / 规划与执行”; source section says “查看题目来源背景与延伸阅读”. At bottom, a related-question comparison table with three questions and a “主要观察差异” column: “当多个重要项目竞争有限资源时，你如何确定优先级？”, “如果上级的优先级与团队判断不一致，你会如何处理？”, “在目标不变但资源减少的情况下，你会如何调整计划？”. Mark their differences as “排序依据”, “分歧处理”, “约束变化”. The page should make causal relationship and comparison obvious without implying answers. Calm, readable, useful, attractive, consistent with Starlight and Radix restraint. No fictional metrics, sourced claims, answers, ratings, illustrations, slogans, charts with fake data, or browser frame.
